text: Based on the provided tool output, all of the 2021 tree-cover loss within the asset occurred inside the pine plantation. The observations indicate that the loss area of 81.3 hectares is primarily within the planted forest area, with 68.1 hectares of planted pine forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda) affected. Only 13.2 hectares of the loss area was outside the mapped forest. Therefore, the vast majority of the loss was indeed within the pine plantation.
